newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Taiwan buys Sept naphtha at below $210/T.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan buys Sept naphtha at below $210/T.

text.p: Taiwan's state-owned Chinese Petroleum Corp (CPC) bought by tender 28,000 tonnes of naphthenic-and-aromatic (N+A) naphtha for September 11-20 delivery at below $210 per tonne, cost-and-freight (c-and-f) Kaohsiung, a CPC official said on Friday.
"The award was a little lower than $210," the official said.
The tender closed on July 31 and was valid for one day.
The latest award is higher than CPC's previous N+A purchase, for August 15-31 delivery, which was at $196 per tonne, c-and-f basis.
"We are not as happy with the level, but we have no choice," the official said.
CPC did not plan to purchase any more N+A cargoes for September, the official said.
